<!DOCTYPE html><!-- We set all theme classes to allow critters to inline the theme styles and prevent flickering --><html lang="en" class="docs-dark-mode docs-light-mode"><head>
    <script>
      // This logic must execute early, so that we set the necessary
      // CSS classes to the document node and avoid unstyled content
      // from appearing on the page.
      const THEME_PREFERENCE_LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY = 'themePreference';
      const DARK_MODE_CLASS_NAME = 'docs-dark-mode';
      const LIGHT_MODE_CLASS_NAME = 'docs-light-mode';
      const PREFERS_COLOR_SCHEME_DARK = '(prefers-color-scheme: dark)';

      const theme = localStorage.getItem(THEME_PREFERENCE_LOCAL_STORAGE_KEY) ?? 'auto';
      const prefersDark = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia(PREFERS_COLOR_SCHEME_DARK).matches;
      const documentClassList = this.document.documentElement.classList;

      // clearing classes before setting them.
      this.document.documentElement.className = '';
      if (theme === 'dark' || (theme === 'auto' && prefersDark)) {
        documentClassList.add(DARK_MODE_CLASS_NAME);
      } else {
        documentClassList.add(LIGHT_MODE_CLASS_NAME);
      }

      if (location.search.includes('uwu')) {
        documentClassList.add('uwu');
      }
    </script>
    <style>
      .uwu-logo {
        display: none;
      }
      html.uwu .angular-logo {
        display: none;
      }
      html.uwu .uwu-logo {
        display: block !important;
      }
    </style>

  <!-- Page title -->
  <div class="docs-page-title">
    <h1 tabindex="-1">Accepting data with input properties</h1>
    <a class="docs-github-links" target="_blank" href="https://github.com/angular/angular/edit/main/adev/src/content/guide/components/inputs.md" title="Edit this page" aria-label="Edit this page">
      <!-- Pencil -->
      <docs-icon role="presentation" aria-hidden="true" translate="no" ng-version="22.2.1+sha-ef03596" class="material-symbols-outlined" _nghost-ng-c1001676203="" style="font-size: 0px;" ngh="0"></docs-icon>
    </a>
  </div>
    </header>
    
      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-tip">
        <p><strong>TIP:</strong> This guide assumes you've already read the <a href="essentials">Essentials Guide</a>. Read that first if you're new to Angular. If you're familiar with other web frameworks, input properties are similar to <em>props</em>.</p>
      </div>
      <p>When you use a component, you commonly want to pass some data to it. A component specifies the data that it accepts by declaring
<strong>inputs</strong>:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, input} </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">from</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> '@angular/core'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Declare an input named 'value' with a default value of zero.</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>This lets you bind to the property in a template:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [value]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"50"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>If an input has a default value, TypeScript infers the type from the default value:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // TypeScript infers that this input is a number, returning InputSignal&lt;number&gt;.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>You can explicitly declare a type for the input by specifying a generic parameter to the function.</p>
<p>If an input without a default value is not set, its value is <code>undefined</code>:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Produces an InputSignal&lt;number | undefined&gt; because `value` may not be set.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p><strong>Angular records inputs statically at compile-time</strong>. Inputs cannot be added or removed at run-time.</p>
<p>The <code>input</code> function has special meaning to the Angular compiler. <strong>You can exclusively call <code>input</code> in component and directive property initializers.</strong></p>
<p>When extending a component class, <strong>inputs are inherited by the child class.</strong></p>
<p><strong>Input names are case-sensitive.</strong></p>

  <docs-table-of-contents toc-skip-content="true" ng-version="22.2.1+sha-ef03596" _nghost-ng-c640989826="" ngh="9"><aside _ngcontent-ng-c640989826=""><nav _ngcontent-ng-c640989826=""><header _ngcontent-ng-c640989826=""><h2 _ngcontent-ng-c640989826="" class="docs-title">On this page</h2></header><ul _ngcontent-ng-c640989826="" class="docs-faceted-list"><!----></ul></nav><button _ngcontent-ng-c640989826="" type="button" jsaction="click:;"><docs-icon _ngcontent-ng-c640989826="" aria-hidden="true" translate="no" role="presentation" class="material-symbols-outlined" _nghost-ng-c1001676203="" style="font-size: 0px;" ngh="0">arrow_upward_alt</docs-icon> Back to the top </button></aside></docs-table-of-contents><h2 id="reading-inputs">
    <a href="#reading-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Reading inputs">Reading inputs</a>
  </h2>
  <p>The <code>input</code> function returns an <a href="/api/core/InputSignal"><code>InputSignal</code></a>. You can read the value by calling the signal:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, input, </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/computed">computed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">} </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">from</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> '@angular/core'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Declare an input named 'value' with a default value of zero.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Create a computed expression that reads the value input</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  label</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/computed">computed</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> `The slider's value is ${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">()</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">}`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Signals created by the <code>input</code> function are read-only.</p>

  <h2 id="required-inputs">
    <a href="#required-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Required inputs">Required inputs</a>
  </h2>
  <p>You can declare that an input is <code>required</code> by calling <a href="/api/core/input#required"><code>input.required</code></a> instead of <code>input</code>:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Declare a required input named value. Returns an `InputSignal&lt;number&gt;`.</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> input.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">required</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&gt;();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Angular enforces that required inputs <em>must</em> be set when the component is used in a template. If you try to use a component without specifying all of its required inputs, Angular reports an error at build-time.</p>
<p>Required inputs do not automatically include <code>undefined</code> in the generic parameter of the returned <a href="/api/core/InputSignal"><code>InputSignal</code></a>.</p>

  <h2 id="configuring-inputs">
    <a href="#configuring-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Configuring inputs">Configuring inputs</a>
  </h2>
  <p>The <code>input</code> function accepts a config object as a second parameter that lets you change the way that input works.</p>

  <h3 id="input-transforms">
    <a href="#input-transforms" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Input transforms">Input transforms</a>
  </h3>
  <p>You can specify a <code>transform</code> function to change the value of an input when it's set by Angular.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'custom-slider'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /*...*/</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  label</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {transform: trimString});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">function</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> trimString</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> value?.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">trim</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">??</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> ''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [label]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"systemVolume"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>In the example above, whenever the value of <code>systemVolume</code> changes, Angular runs <code>trimString</code> and sets <code>label</code> to the result.</p>
<p>The most common use-case for input transforms is to accept a wider range of value types in templates, often including <code>null</code> and <code>undefined</code>.</p>
<p><strong>Input transform function must be statically analyzable at build-time.</strong> You cannot set transform functions conditionally or as the result of an expression evaluation.</p>
<p><strong>Input transform functions should always be <a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pure_function" target="_blank">pure functions</a>.</strong> Relying on state outside the transform function can lead to unpredictable behavior.</p>

  <h4 id="type-checking">
    <a href="#type-checking" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Type checking">Type checking</a>
  </h4>
  <p>When you specify an input transform, the type of the transform function's parameter determines the types of values that can be set to the input in a template.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  widthPx</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {transform: appendPx});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">function</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> appendPx</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> `${</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">}px`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>In the example above, the <code>widthPx</code> input accepts a <code>number</code> while the <a href="/api/core/InputSignal"><code>InputSignal</code></a> property returns a <code>string</code>.</p>

  <h4 id="built-in-transformations">
    <a href="#built-in-transformations" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Built-in transformations">Built-in transformations</a>
  </h4>
  <p>Angular includes two built-in transform functions for the two most common scenarios: coercing values to boolean and numbers.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">import</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, input, </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/booleanAttribute">booleanAttribute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/numberAttribute">numberAttribute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">} </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">from</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> '@angular/core'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  disabled</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">false</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {transform: </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/booleanAttribute">booleanAttribute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {transform: </span><a style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8" href="/api/core/numberAttribute">numberAttribute</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p><a href="/api/core/booleanAttribute"><code>booleanAttribute</code></a> imitates the behavior of standard HTML <a href="https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Glossary/Boolean/HTML" target="_blank">boolean attributes</a>, where the
<em>presence</em> of the attribute indicates a "true" value. However, Angular's <a href="/api/core/booleanAttribute"><code>booleanAttribute</code></a> treats the literal string <code>"false"</code> as the boolean <code>false</code>.</p>
<p><a href="/api/core/numberAttribute"><code>numberAttribute</code></a> attempts to parse the given value to a number, producing <code>NaN</code> if parsing fails.</p>

  <h3 id="input-aliases">
    <a href="#input-aliases" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Input aliases">Input aliases</a>
  </h3>
  <p>You can specify the <code>alias</code> option to change the name of an input in templates.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> input</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">, {alias: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'sliderValue'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [sliderValue]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"50"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>This alias does not affect usage of the property in TypeScript code.</p>
<p>While you should generally avoid aliasing inputs for components, this feature can be useful for renaming properties while preserving an alias for the original name or for avoiding collisions with the name of native DOM element properties.</p>

  <h2 id="model-inputs">
    <a href="#model-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Model inputs">Model inputs</a>
  </h2>
  <p><strong>Model inputs</strong> are a special type of input that enable a component to propagate new values back to its parent component.</p>
<p>When creating a component, you can define a model input similarly to how you create a standard input.</p>
<p>Both types of input allow someone to bind a value into the property. However, <strong>model inputs allow the component author to write values into the property</strong>. If the property is bound with a two-way binding, the new value propagates to that binding.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Define a model input named "value".</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/model">model</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">  increment</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">    // Update the model input with a new value, propagating the value to any bindings.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">    this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.value.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">update</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">((</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">oldValue</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> oldValue </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">+</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 10</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /* ... */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Using the two-way binding syntax means that any changes to the slider's</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // value automatically propagate back to the `volume` signal.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Note that this binding uses the signal *instance*, not the signal value.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">`&lt;custom-slider [(value)]="volume" /&gt;`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> MediaControls</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Create a writable signal for the `volume` local state.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  volume</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/signal">signal</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>In the above example, the <code>CustomSlider</code> can write values into its <code>value</code> model input, which then propagates those values back to the <code>volume</code> signal in <code>MediaControls</code>. This binding keeps the values of <code>value</code> and <code>volume</code> in sync. Notice that the binding passes the <code>volume</code> signal instance, not the <em>value</em> of the signal.</p>
<p>In other respects, model inputs work similarly to standard inputs. You can read the value by calling the signal function, including in <a href="guide/signals#reactive-contexts">reactive contexts</a> like <a href="/api/core/computed"><code>computed</code></a> and <a href="/api/core/effect"><code>effect</code></a>.</p>
<p>See <a href="guide/templates/two-way-binding">Two-way binding</a> for more details on two-way binding in templates.</p>

  <h3 id="two-way-binding-with-plain-properties">
    <a href="#two-way-binding-with-plain-properties" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Two-way binding with plain properties">Two-way binding with plain properties</a>
  </h3>
  <p>You can bind a plain JavaScript property to a model input.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  /* ... */</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // `value` is a model input.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // The parenthesis-inside-square-brackets syntax (aka "banana-in-a-box") creates a two-way binding</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  template: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [(value)]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"volume"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> MediaControls</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  protected</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> volume</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>In the example above, the <code>CustomSlider</code> can write values into its <code>value</code> model input, which then propagates those values back to the <code>volume</code> property in <code>MediaControls</code>. This binding keeps the values of <code>value</code> and <code>volume</code> in sync.</p>

  <h3 id="implicit-change-events">
    <a href="#implicit-change-events" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Implicit change events">Implicit <code>change</code> events</a>
  </h3>
  <p>When you declare a model input in a component or directive, Angular automatically creates a corresponding <a href="guide/components/outputs">output</a> for that model. The output's name is the model input's name suffixed with "Change".</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Directive">Directive</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomCheckbox</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // This automatically creates an output named "checkedChange".</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">  // Can be subscribed to using `(checkedChange)="handler()"` in the template.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">  checked</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> </span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/model">model</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">false</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Angular emits this change event whenever you write a new value into the model input by calling its <code>set</code> or <code>update</code> methods.</p>
<p>See <a href="guide/components/outputs">Custom events with outputs</a> for more details on outputs.</p>

  <h3 id="customizing-model-inputs">
    <a href="#customizing-model-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Customizing model inputs">Customizing model inputs</a>
  </h3>
  <p>You can mark a model input as <a href="#required-inputs">required</a> or provide an <a href="#input-aliases">alias</a> in the same way as a standard input.</p>
<p>Model inputs do not support input transforms.</p>

  <h3 id="when-to-use-model-inputs">
    <a href="#when-to-use-model-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to When to use model inputs">When to use model inputs</a>
  </h3>
  <p>Use model inputs when you want a component to support two-way binding. This is typically appropriate when a component exists to modify a value based on user interaction. Most commonly, custom form controls, such as a date picker or combobox, should use model inputs for their primary value.</p>

  <h2 id="choosing-input-names">
    <a href="#choosing-input-names" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Choosing input names">Choosing input names</a>
  </h2>
  <p>Avoid choosing input names that collide with properties on DOM elements like HTMLElement. Name collisions introduce confusion about whether the bound property belongs to the component or the DOM element.</p>
<p>Avoid adding prefixes for component inputs like you would with component selectors. Since a given element can only host one component, any custom properties can be assumed to belong to the component.</p>

  <h2 id="declaring-inputs-with-the-input-decorator">
    <a href="#declaring-inputs-with-the-input-decorator" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Declaring inputs with the @Input decorator">Declaring inputs with the <code>@Input</code> decorator</a>
  </h2>
  
      <div class="docs-alert docs-alert-tip">
        <p><strong>TIP:</strong> While the Angular team recommends using the signal-based <code>input</code> function for new projects, the original decorator-based <a href="/api/core/Input"><code>@Input</code></a> API remains fully supported.</p>
      </div>
      <p>You can alternatively declare component inputs by adding the <a href="/api/core/Input"><code>@Input</code></a> decorator to a property:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>Binding to an input is the same in both signal-based and decorator-based inputs:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [value]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"50"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h3 id="customizing-decorator-based-inputs">
    <a href="#customizing-decorator-based-inputs" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Customizing decorator-based inputs">Customizing decorator-based inputs</a>
  </h3>
  <p>The <a href="/api/core/Input"><code>@Input</code></a> decorator accepts a config object that lets you change the way that input works.</p>

  <h4 id="required-inputs-decorator">
    <a href="#required-inputs-decorator" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Required inputs">Required inputs</a>
  </h4>
  <p>You can specify the <code>required</code> option to enforce that a given input must always have a value.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({required: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">true</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>If you try to use a component without specifying all of its required inputs, Angular reports an error at build-time.</p>

  <h4 id="input-transforms-decorator">
    <a href="#input-transforms-decorator" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Input transforms">Input transforms</a>
  </h4>
  <p>You can specify a <code>transform</code> function to change the value of an input when it's set by Angular. This transform function works identically to transform functions for signal-based inputs described above.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  selector: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'custom-slider'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  ...</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({transform: trimString}) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">label</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> ''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">function</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> trimString</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> string</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> |</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> undefined</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> value?.</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0">trim</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">() </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">??</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF"> ''</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div>
  <h4 id="input-aliases-decorator">
    <a href="#input-aliases-decorator" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Input aliases">Input aliases</a>
  </h4>
  <p>You can specify the <code>alias</code> option to change the name of an input in templates.</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">/* ... */</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({alias: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'sliderValue'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}) </span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">&lt;</span><span style="--shiki-light:#22863A;--shiki-dark:#85E89D">custom-slider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> [sliderValue]</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">"50"</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> /&gt;</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>The <a href="/api/core/Input"><code>@Input</code></a> decorator also accepts the alias as its first parameter in place of the config object.</p>
<p>Input aliases work the same way as for signal-based inputs described above.</p>

  <h3 id="inputs-with-getters-and-setters">
    <a href="#inputs-with-getters-and-setters" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Inputs with getters and setters">Inputs with getters and setters</a>
  </h3>
  <p>When using decorator-based inputs, a property implemented with a getter and setter can be an input:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  get</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">()</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">    return</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.internalValue;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  set</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">newValue</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">    this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.internalValue </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> newValue;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> internalValue</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>You can even create a <em>write-only</em> input by only defining a public setter:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  @</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Input">Input</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">()</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  set</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> value</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70">newValue</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">:</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> number</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF">    this</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">.internalValue </span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">=</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> newValue;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  private</span><span style="--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70"> internalValue</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> =</span><span style="--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF"> 0</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p><strong>Prefer using input transforms instead of getters and setters</strong> if possible.</p>
<p>Avoid complex or costly getters and setters. Angular may invoke an input's setter multiple times, which may negatively impact application performance if the setter performs any costly behaviors, such as DOM manipulation.</p>

  <h2 id="specify-inputs-in-the-component-decorator">
    <a href="#specify-inputs-in-the-component-decorator" class="docs-anchor" tabindex="-1" aria-label="Link to Specify inputs in the @Component decorator">Specify inputs in the <code>@Component</code> decorator</a>
  </h2>
  <p>In addition to the <a href="/api/core/Input"><code>@Input</code></a> decorator, you can also specify a component's inputs with the <code>inputs</code> property in the <a href="/api/core/Component"><code>@Component</code></a> decorator. This can be useful when a component inherits a property from a base class:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// `CustomSlider` inherits the `disabled` property from `BaseSlider`.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  ...</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  inputs: [</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'disabled'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> extends</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> BaseSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> { }</span></span></code></pre>
  </div><p>You can additionally specify an input alias in the <code>inputs</code> list by putting the alias after a colon in the string:</p>
<div class="docs-code">
    
    <pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark" style="--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D">// `CustomSlider` inherits the `disabled` property from `BaseSlider`.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">@</span><a style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0" href="/api/core/Component">Component</a><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">  ...</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line highlighted"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">  inputs: [</span><span style="--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF">'disabled: sliderDisabled'</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8">})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583">export</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> class</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> CustomSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583"> extends</span><span style="--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0"> BaseSlider</span><span style="--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8"> { }</span></span></code></pre>
  </div></main><!----><!----></docs-docs><!----></adev-main><!----><footer _ngcontent-ng-c1178817259="" adev-footer="" _nghost-ng-c3322347427="" ngh="0"><div _ngcontent-ng-c3322347427="" input\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line highlighted\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70\">  label\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>Signals created by the \u003Ccode>input\u003C\u002Fcode> function are read-only.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch2 id=\"required-inputs\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#required-inputs\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Required inputs\">Required inputs\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh2>\n  \u003Cp>You can declare that an input is \u003Ccode>required\u003C\u002Fcode> by calling \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Finput#required\">\u003Ccode>input.required\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> instead of \u003Ccode>input\u003C\u002Fcode>:\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">@\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Ca style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\" href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FComponent\">Component\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan Returns an `InputSignal&lt;number&gt;`.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line highlighted\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#E36209;--shiki-dark:#FFAB70\">  value\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#D73A49;--shiki-dark:#F97583\"> =\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\"> input.\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6F42C1;--shiki-dark:#B392F0\">required\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF\">number\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&gt;();\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>Angular enforces that required inputs \u003Cem>must\u003C\u002Fem> be set when the component is used in a template. If you try to use a component without specifying all of its required inputs, Angular reports an error at build-time.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Required inputs do not automatically include \u003Ccode>undefined\u003C\u002Fcode> in the generic parameter of the returned \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FInputSignal\">\u003Ccode>InputSignal\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch2 id=\"configuring-inputs\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#configuring-inputs\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Configuring inputs\">Configuring inputs\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh2>\n  \u003Cp>The \u003Ccode>input\u003C\u002Fcode> function accepts a config object as a second parameter that lets you change the way that input works.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"input-transforms\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#input-transforms\" class=\"docs-anchor\" of \u003Ccode>systemVolume\u003C\u002Fcode> changes, Angular runs \u003Ccode>trimString\u003C\u002Fcode> and sets \u003Ccode>label\u003C\u002Fcode> to the result.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>The most common use-case for input transforms is to accept a wider range of value types in templates, often including \u003Ccode>null\u003C\u002Fcode> and \u003Ccode>undefined\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Input transform function must be statically analyzable at build-time.\u003C\u002Fstrong> You cannot set transform functions conditionally or as the result of an expression evaluation.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Input transform functions should always be \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fen.wikipedia.org\u002Fwiki\u002FPure_function\" target=\"_blank\">pure functions\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fstrong> Relying on state outside the transform function can lead to unpredictable behavior.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch4 id=\"type-checking\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#type-checking\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Type checking\">Type checking\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh4>\n  \u003Cp>When you specify an input transform, the type of the transform function's parameter determines the types of values that can be set to the input in transformations\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh4>\n  \u003Cp>Angular includes two built-in transform functions for the two most common scenarios: coercing values to boolean and input\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#005CC5;--shiki-dark:#79B8FF\">0\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">}\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fpre>\n  \u003C\u002Fdiv>\u003Cp>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FbooleanAttribute\">\u003Ccode>booleanAttribute\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> imitates the behavior of standard HTML \u003Ca href=\"https:\u002F\u002Fdeveloper.mozilla.org\u002Fdocs\u002FGlossary\u002FBoolean\u002FHTML\" target=\"_blank\">boolean attributes\u003C\u002Fa>, where the\n\u003Cem>presence\u003C\u002Fem> of the attribute indicates a \"true\" value. However, Angular's \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FbooleanAttribute\">\u003Ccode>booleanAttribute\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> treats the literal string \u003Ccode>&quot;false&quot;\u003C\u002Fcode> as the boolean \u003Ccode>false\u003C\u002Fcode>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>\u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002FnumberAttribute\">\u003Ccode>numberAttribute\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> attempts to parse the given value to a number, producing \u003Ccode>NaN\u003C\u002Fcode> if parsing fails.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"input-aliases\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#input-aliases\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Input aliases\">Input aliases\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh3>\n  \u003Cp>You can specify the \u003Ccode>alias\u003C\u002Fcode> option to change the name of an input in templates.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\"   \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light github-dark\" style=\"--shiki-light:#24292e;--shiki-dark:#e1e4e8;--shiki-light-bg:#fff;--shiki-dark-bg:#24292e\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003Ccode>\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">&lt;\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan property in TypeScript code.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>While you should generally avoid aliasing inputs for components, this feature can be useful for renaming properties while preserving an alias for the original name or for avoiding collisions with the name of native DOM element properties.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch2 id=\"model-inputs\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#model-inputs\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Model inputs\">Model inputs\u003C\u002Fa>\n  \u003C\u002Fh2>\n  \u003Cp>\u003Cstrong>Model inputs\u003C\u002Fstrong> are a special type of input that enable a component to propagate new values back to its parent component.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>When creating a component, you can define a model input similarly to how you create a standard input.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>Both types of input allow someone to bind a value into the property. However, \u003Cstrong>model inputs allow the component author to write values into the property\u003C\u002Fstrong>. If the property is bound with a two-way binding, the new value propagates to that binding.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cdiv class=\"docs-code\">\n    \n    \u003Cpre class=\"shiki shiki-themes github-light *\u002F\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003C\u002Fspan>\n\u003Cspan class=\"line\">\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#6A737D;--shiki-dark:#6A737D\">  \u002F\u002F Using the two-way binding syntax means that any \u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#032F62;--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF\">`&lt;custom-slider [(value)]=\"volume\" \u002F&gt;`\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Fsignal\">signal\u003C\u002Fa>\u003Cspan style=\"--shiki-light:#24292E;--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8\">(\u003C\u002Fspan>\u003Cspan \u003Ccode>CustomSlider\u003C\u002Fcode> can write values into its \u003Ccode>value\u003C\u002Fcode> model input, which then propagates those values back to the \u003Ccode>volume\u003C\u002Fcode> signal in \u003Ccode>MediaControls\u003C\u002Fcode>. This binding keeps the values of \u003Ccode>value\u003C\u002Fcode> and \u003Ccode>volume\u003C\u002Fcode> in sync. Notice that the binding passes the \u003Ccode>volume\u003C\u002Fcode> signal instance, not the \u003Cem>value\u003C\u002Fem> of the signal.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>In other respects, model inputs work similarly to standard inputs. You can read the value by calling the signal function, including in \u003Ca href=\"guide\u002Fsignals#reactive-contexts\">reactive contexts\u003C\u002Fa> like \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Fcomputed\">\u003Ccode>computed\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa> and \u003Ca href=\"\u002Fapi\u002Fcore\u002Feffect\">\u003Ccode>effect\u003C\u002Fcode>\u003C\u002Fa>.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\u003Cp>See \u003Ca href=\"guide\u002Ftemplates\u002Ftwo-way-binding\">Two-way binding\u003C\u002Fa> for more details on two-way binding in templates.\u003C\u002Fp>\n\n  \u003Ch3 id=\"two-way-binding-with-plain-properties\">\n    \u003Ca href=\"#two-way-binding-with-plain-properties\" class=\"docs-anchor\" tabindex=\"-1\" aria-label=\"Link to Two-way binding with plain properties\">Two-way binding with plain properties\u003C\u002Fa>\n
